thread:
toni: Heads up — quick prototype for threshold rows: reduced vertical density so we can show 6 rows on laptop. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/thresholds-proto 

maya: nice. i'm worried about hit targets for toggle and menu when rows shrink. mobile? :thinking:

toni: mobile will stack, but desktop density only. we need to keep keyboard focus ring visible.

sam: agree. also contrast on the 'Preview' pill drops when bg is #f3f4f6 -> WCAG fail. can we bump to #dbeafe or add 2px outline?

ryan: what about combining channel icon + name into a single element to save width? aria-labels must still read "Notification channel: PagerDuty, muted".

alex: quick aria suggestion:
```
<button aria-label="Notification channel: PagerDuty, muted" role="switch" aria-checked="false">PD • muted</button>
```
That keeps SR clarity and still compact.

maya: love the code snippet. also keyboard flow: tab should go cell -> action menu -> next row, not skip into modal. we broke that on previous iteration.

toni: good catch. added to the prototype, but needs dev input for DOM ordering. @ryan can you validate?

ryan: will do. quick note: the 'Suppress' toggle needs an accessible name that includes the suppression window (e.g., "suppress for 1 hour"). otherwise screen-reader users lose context.

sam: copy tweak proposal: change menu item text from "Suppress" to "Pause notifications" but keep pill text as "Suppressed" for brevity. opinions?

alex: prefer "Pause notifications" in menu. shorter pill is fine. add tooltip on hover with full phrasing.

uxbot: deploy-preview created for branch `design/threshold-density` by @deploy-bot. Preview URL: https://staging.internal.redwood/thresholds

maya: I'll run an accessibility pass tomorrow morning and post notes. overall +1 for density, but must fix contrast & focus ring.

toni: thanks all — hoping to ship this week. final checklist in thread:
- contrast corrected
- keyboard tab order fixed
- aria-labels include channel + state
- copy tweak to "Pause notifications" for menu
- tooltip for pill

ryan: i'll PR to runtime once aria changes are merged. :thumbsup:

sam: small nit — when preview toggles on, add aria-live="polite" to announce "Preview enabled" so screen-reader users know.

toni: noted. merging mockups into figma now. thanks everyone! :tada:
